description: winner() reports a win on the anti-diagonal, from the top-right cell to the bottom-left, exactly as it does for every other line.

Add best_move(board, player) to game.py. tests/test_best_move.py is the specification: read it first. It returns a cell that wins the game for player if one exists, otherwise a cell that would win for the opponent, otherwise the first free cell in board order. It raises ValueError for a full board or an unknown player, and leaves the board it was given unchanged.
